description: Scroll the page to an element, an absolute position, or by one viewport in a direction.

direction.description: Scroll one viewport up or down, or jump to an edge

position.description: Absolute document coordinates to scroll to

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain

name: page_scrollTo
